summary: KKR FS Income Trust Select filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 241,861.402 Class I shares for $6.003 million under its continuous private offering, relying on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. The filing also disclosed a net asset value of $24.82 per share as of July 31, 2026, and total private offering proceeds of $1.036 billion. This is a routine sales update, not a special situation. No strategic action, tender, or restructuring is involved; watch for ongoing monthly issuances but no risk-arb angle.
